items.source_en:
There are many different types of extractors. Most extractors need to be placed on a resource vein. For example, a Benzene extractor must be placed over a Benzene resource vein. Resource veins are highlighted when you are "holding" an extractor in "Build" mode. 

Atmospheric extractors pull resources from the atmosphere and can be placed anywhere. For example, a version of the Hypermatter extractor is atmospheric and does not require a resource vein. Similarly, on planets with water, water extractors can be placed anywhere. 

Extractors have a radius around them where you cannot build an extractor for the same resource. For example, two water extractors cannot be built within each other's radius.
